title: Tailwind versus CSS? The question is wrong. #programmazione #webdevelopment #ai #javascript #api
description: Tailwind doesn't replace CSS — it generates it. Utilities for speed and consistency, custom CSS for precision. Don't pick a side. Choose the right level of abstraction.
